# LadderLab

LadderLab is an open educational web laboratory with two areas: PLC Ladder Logic and a browser-native DC electronics workbench.

- Ladder: visual IEC 61131-3 editor, conveyor simulation and industrial safety scenarios.
- General: component placement, terminal wiring, DC network solving, instruments and oscilloscope.

- [Source code and documentation](https://github.com/f-lopez-velazquez/ladderlab)
- [Project creator](https://zolvek.com.mx)

The simulator must not be used to control real machinery or replace certified safety engineering.
